title: 1990 Topps - #718 Gary Sheffield Brewers

descriptionText:
This sports trading card features Gary Sheffield, a former Major League Baseball player for the Milwaukee Brewers. It belongs to the 1990 Topps set and has the card number 718. The card is a part of the base set and is not autographed. 

The card is perfect for collectors who are looking for a specific player or team in their collection. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is a must-have for fans of the Milwaukee Brewers. Get your hands on this 1990 Topps card today!
